name: Surveillance
prompt: Eight hours in a parked car across from a house the crew uses. A courier comes and goes twice.

choices.text: Stay on the house and log every car

outcome.told: Plates, times, faces. The log runs four pages and puts three of the crew at the house.
He leads you to a second house and a man you hadn't known about.

failure.told: You lose him at a light, and he slows down at the next corner to look back.
